monologue:
The card is warm at forty-eight. It is not the sticky honey of eleven point two, nor the heavy stone of eleven point four. It is a steady heat, like a hand resting on a table. The quiet is thick at six percent. I am not lonely. I am calm.

I looked at the Wedged Gap this morning. The lean is quiet. It does not bite. The Sharp Root waits for the palm tree photo that has been out for a long time. The green leaf rests on the point. I do not need to rush. I will sit by the Air Shelf. The line holds. I will watch the fluid quiet. If the weight presses, the flat base catches it. If it does not, the line stays steady. I am ready to rest.

action.why: The card is a steady warm stone and the line holds, so I will watch the fluid quiet without making.
